name: Crystalline Reflection reflects damage absorbed by the Cultist's own Void Shield, not only an ally's (#4983)
contract: Crystalline Reflection 525060 reads 'Increases the chance for Void Shield to resist dispel effects on allies by 50% and it now also reflects 50% of the damage absorbed.' (Ascension tooltip capture). 'On allies' qualifies the dispel resistance; the reflect clause has no target restriction, and Void Shield 500715 ('Shields an ally') can be cast on the Cultist. aura_ascension_cultist_lifecycle::AfterAbsorb reflects by casting 525062 from the Cultist on the attacker with 50% of the absorbed amount. #4983: it skipped the reflect whenever the shield was on the Cultist. Asserted: with 525060 learned, an enemy Frostbolt 42842 absorbed by Void Shield on an ally makes the Cultist deal 525062 damage to that enemy (control), and a Frostbolt absorbed by Void Shield on the Cultist does the same.
